About the AK-47 | Point Disarray

Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors. Perfect for the insurgent on the go The AK-47 | Point Disarray is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Point Disarray finish on the AK-47. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AK-47 | Point Disarray can be unboxed from the Revolver Case. It belongs to the Revolver Case Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.67. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AK-47 | Point Disarray (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $107.13, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $15.36 (Battle-Scarred) to $107.13 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The AK-47 | Point Disarray has a community rating of 3.6 out of 5 based on 265 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AK-47 skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AK-47 | Point Disarray?

Factory New (FN) AK-47 | Point Disarray skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Point Disarray pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the AK-47 | Point Disarray worth the price?

The AK-47 | Point Disarray sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Point Disarray design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Revolver Case Collection, obtainable from the Revolver Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the AK-47, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the AK-47 | Point Disarray?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.67, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the AK-47 | Point Disarray?

Prices for the AK-47 | Point Disarray vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Revolver Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the AK-47 | Point Disarray in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AK-47 | Point Disarray are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the AK-47 | Point Disarray price going up or down?

The AK-47 | Point Disarray has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the AK-47 | Point Disarray from?

The AK-47 | Point Disarray is part of the The Revolver Case Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Revolver Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

The in-game description reads: "Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors. Perfect for the insurgent on the go" The Point Disarray finish on the AK-47 is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.
